messages:
elaine: Heads-up — after the SDK sampling change shipped this morning, the Console quota charts are showing periodic spikes for a subset of tenants. Not real usage increases, looks correlated with sampling threshold changes. Anyone seen this?

sam: Which sampling change? the default sample-rate tweak from 2% -> 5%?

elaine: Yep. We bumped the SDK default to 5% to get more telemetry for debug mode. But the quota dashboard is treating sampled events as full-metered events in the sparkline, so it inflates short windows.

jo: Oof. That sounds like a mapping problem in the metrics ingestion. Is Console ingest counting sample events as regular tokens or as a separate metric?

elaine: From quick grep, console maps incoming telemetry to quota.burn by route WITHOUT checking sample flag. SDK is sending header: `X-Redwood-Telemetry-Sample: 0.05` and a `sampled: true` field, but console pipeline ignores it.

priya: Can you paste an example payload?

elaine: Sure: ```json
{
  "route":"/v1/generate",
  "tenant":"acct_123",
  "tokens":124,
  "sampled":true,
  "sample_rate":0.05
}
```

maria: So each sampled telemetry event carries token counts. If ingestion increments quota.burn by tokens without scaling by 1/sample_rate, dashboards will spike. We should either: (A) scale sampled-events by 1/sample_rate at ingest, or (B) mark them as telemetry-only metrics and not count for quota.

sam: Option A is noisy (amplifies variance) but keeps unit economics accurate. Option B will hide usage and bias quota reporting downward.

jo: There's also a UX question: do we want console charts to show raw telemetry (for debugging) or billable-normalized estimates? We have two consumers: Ops (wants raw) and Finance (wants billable).

elaine: Short-term I think we should patch ingestion so the quota dashboard uses normalized tokens = tokens * (1 / sample_rate) for sampled events when computing quota burn. Longer term add a toggle in Console to switch between "raw telemetry" and "billable estimate" views.

priya: Agreed for patch. Who owns the ingestion rule? eng-platform?

jo: Eng-platform + Console team. I'll open a quick RFC and a hotfix PR for edgecases. We should also revert SDK default to 2% until Console respects the sample flag.

sam: Can we do a conservative hotfix: if `sampled==true` and `sample_rate` present, multiply tokens by (1/sample_rate) when writing to quota. Also add a rate-limited alert when normalized tokens exceed threshold so SRE can confirm.

maria: I'll add a metric filter in the pipeline (ingest-mapper) and a unit test. PR incoming.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: eng-platform/ingest-mapper #432 -> staging at 1718624440 by maria

elaine: Thanks. Also filing a small SDK patch to bump telemetry opt-in: revert default to 2% and make 5% opt-in behind env var `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_DEBUG=true`. We should note in release notes.

priya: Good call. Please coordinate with devex so docs + Console toggle land at same time.

jo: RFC: https://go/repo/rfcs/telemetry-sampling-normalization — I'll populate with options and timeline.

sam: ETA for hotfix?

maria: PR opened, hoping to stage deploy in ~15m, prod after quick smoke.

elaine: I'll post an internal note to affected customers and mark this as a potential "data discrepancy" issue in Console until resolved.

priya: Sounds good. Postmortem if anything goes sideways. :thumbsup:

jo: After this, we should update SDK docs to explicitly call out how sampled telemetry maps to quota and show the Console toggle UX mock.

elaine: Yep. I'll draft the docs and a small changelog blurb.

maria: Staging deploy completed at 1718624490, smoke looks normal, dashboard spike gone for test tenant.

elaine: Awesome — thanks all. We'll keep tracking for 24h and then flip SDK default change back to 5% if the Console toggle and docs are ready.
